seo.title: Our Team - Oceans Alive Foundation
seo.description: Meet the Oceans Alive Foundation team - 18 specialists and community stewards protecting Kenya's coast.

heroThePeopleBehindTheOcean.label: The
heroThePeopleBehindTheOcean.text: 18 specialists. Community stewards. One coastline. Since 2003.

communityStewardsBand.text: Fishers, reef monitors, women leaders, BMU reps, and community rangers - the 7,000+ people who protect Kenya's coast because it is their home.

joinTheTeamCallToAction.label: Join the team.
joinTheTeamCallToAction.text: Marine biologists, educators, communicators, and field researchers - we welcome talent at Kuruwitu and across Kilifi County.
